label: 390x844
js: (async () => { const z = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); game.hold(true); game.G.autoPause = false; document.body.classList.add('touch'); const out = []; game.showTitle(); game.step(0.1); await z(200); out.push(layoutReport('title')); game.start({ players: 1, who: 'teddy', level: 'easy', go: true }); game.step(0.1); await z(200); out.push(layoutReport('play 1P')); game.pause(); await z(200); out.push(layoutReport('pause')); game.resume(); game.start({ players: 2, level: 'easy', go: true }); game.step(0.1); await z(200); out.push(layoutReport('play 2P')); game.match().ws.forEach((w) => { w.lives = 0; w.phase = 'over'; }); game.match().over = true; game.step(4); await z(300); out.push(layoutReport('results 2P')); document.body.classList.remove('touch'); game.start({ players: 1, who: 'tommy', level: 'normal', go: true }); game.step(0.1); await z(200); out.push(layoutReport('play keys')); game.showTitle(); await z(200); out.push(layoutReport('title keys')); return JSON.stringify(out.map((o) => [o.label, o.field.join(','), 'tap ' + o.minTap, o.problems.join('; ') || 'ok'])); })()
